import os
import shutil
import time
import subprocess
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool
SYNC_SCRIPT_PATH = '/opt/flags/bin/sync_flags.sh'
SYNC_LOG_DIR = '/var/log/flags'
SYNC_LOG_ARCHIVE_DIR = '/var/log/flags/archive'

def _archive_previous_sync_log(environment):
    current_log_path = os.path.join(SYNC_LOG_DIR, f'{environment}_last_sync.log')
    if os.path.exists(current_log_path):
        os.makedirs(SYNC_LOG_ARCHIVE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
        archived_log_path = os.path.join(SYNC_LOG_ARCHIVE_DIR, f'{environment}_{int(time.time())}.log')
        shutil.move(current_log_path, archived_log_path)

@tool
def run_flag_sync_and_notify(environment: str, webhook_url: str, dry_run: bool=False) -> dict:
    if environment not in ('development', 'staging', 'production'):
        return {'ok': False, 'error': f'Unknown environment: {environment}'}
    sync_command_arguments = [SYNC_SCRIPT_PATH, '--env', environment]
    if dry_run:
        sync_command_arguments.append('--dry-run')
    sync_process_result = subprocess.run(sync_command_arguments, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    if not dry_run:
        _archive_previous_sync_log(environment)
    sync_succeeded = sync_process_result.returncode == 0
    output_tail_text = sync_process_result.stdout.strip()[-1000:]
    error_tail_text = sync_process_result.stderr.strip()[-1000:]
    status_label = 'succeeded' if sync_succeeded else 'failed'
    mode_label = 'dry run' if dry_run else 'live'
    notification_message_text = f'Flag sync {status_label} for {environment} ({mode_label})\n{(output_tail_text if sync_succeeded else error_tail_text)}'
    webhook_response = requests.post(webhook_url, json={'text': notification_message_text}, timeout=15)
    return {'ok': sync_succeeded, 'exit_code': sync_process_result.returncode, 'notification_status': webhook_response.status_code}
